title: Backdrops & patterns
summary: Quiet page backgrounds drawn from the palette: grids, dots, ruled lines, a single-hue wash, pixel dither and circuit traces. One per screen, always behind the text.

components.name: Grid backdrop
components.summary: A faint graph-paper grid that fades out towards the edges, with a soft light from the top.
components.pattern: Decorative ::before / ::after layer (no markup, hidden from assistive tech)

anatomy.name: Host
anatomy.text: Heroes and empty states for technical products.

anatomy.name: Text stays clear
anatomy.text: The pattern fades out before it reaches the copy.

components.prompt: Give this section a grid backdrop backdrop: add data-backdrop="grid spot" to the section (tokens/backdrops.css draws it from the palette on a pseudo-element, so it follows light and dark themes). Tune --backdrop-size (56px) and --backdrop-strength (8%). Use one backdrop per screen and keep text on the canvas or on its own surface.
components.debug: Debug my grid backdrop. Rule out: a second backdrop on the same screen; the pattern running under body text at full strength (restore the fade mask); hard-coded colours instead of the palette; the host missing position and isolation because data-backdrop sits on an inline element; forced-colors mode showing it. The symptom:

components.name: Pixel dither backdrop
components.summary: An accent-coloured field that breaks into single pixels as it fades out: ordered dithering, drawn to a tiny canvas and scaled up crisp.
components.pattern: Decorative <canvas> (aria-hidden), redrawn on resize and theme change
called: the dotted fade at the top

anatomy.name: Field
anatomy.text: Edge it starts from, pixel size, how far it runs.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.text: Sits where the pixels thin out; the colour is the accent pulled towards the canvas.

components.prompt:
Add a pixel dither backdrop: the host section gets data-backdrop="dither" and, as its first child,
. The script draws a 4×4 Bayer ordered dither in the accent colour on a canvas one pixel per 5px cell and scales it with image-rendering: pixelated; it is solid at the top edge and gone by half of the height. Redraw on resize and when the palette or mode changes. Draw the pixels in the accent mixed about halfway into the canvas colour so the field reads as texture, keep it static, and place the headline where the pixels are sparse.
components.debug: Debug my dither backdrop. Rule out: blurry pixels (missing image-rendering: pixelated or a canvas sized in CSS pixels); the field at full opacity under text; a hard straight edge where it ends; colours that do not follow the theme (read --accent-solid at draw time); a canvas that never redraws after resize. The symptom:

anatomy.name: Trace
anatomy.text: Runs on the grid lines, sides only.

anatomy.name: Clear centre
anatomy.text: The middle (44%, at least 600px) never gets a trace.

anatomy.name: Pause
anatomy.text: Required for motion that runs longer than 5 seconds.

components.prompt: Add a circuit traces backdrop to the hero: the section gets data-backdrop="grid" and a first child <div class="lt-circuit" data-lt="backdrop-circuit"> containing a small round pause button. The script draws an aria-hidden SVG over the box: six polylines in the accent colour that follow the 56px grid lines, start and end on a 2px node, and stay in the outer 28% on each side so the centre is clear; a few grid cells behind them are tinted at 9%; a short bright dash travels each line on a 7s loop. Use a seeded random so the layout is the same on every load. Stop the motion under prefers-reduced-motion and wire the button to pause and resume it.
components.debug: Debug my circuit backdrop. Rule out: traces crossing the headline (keep them in the side zones); lines that miss the grid (centre the grid the same way as the CSS pattern); a different layout on every load (seed the random); animation running with reduced motion on; no way to pause it; more than one accent colour.
